Bedrock uniBTC on BSC is a mint/burn wrapper: the anyone-callable functions (vault.mint(address,uint256), uniBTC.burn, batchTransfer) pay the caller nothing - the user supplies the BTC-side asset at peg and pays their own gas; the only functions that move protocol funds are role-gated (vault.execute OPERATOR_ROLE, uniBTC.withdraw DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, BurnProxy/TransferProxy onlyOwner). No stranger is paid anywhere in the 7-day window.
